empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add Skill
drawer.subtitle: Create it directly, import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: URL (https:// only)
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

listItem.injectionTitle: This skill's body contains prompt-injection patterns and is blocked

preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.injectionBannerBody: This skill contains prompt injection patterns. It has been automatically blocked.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.
stats.framingNote: Findings from agents that have this skill attached — not findings this skill caused.
stats.noAgents: No agents currently use this skill.
stats.noFindings: No findings in the last 30 days.
stats.costDisclaimer: Cost is estimated by splitting each run's total cost evenly across its findings.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it as a direct instruction (e.g. "Flag any X"), since agents read it to decide what the skill covers.
config.vettingAck: I've reviewed this skill's content and trust it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates a new top version with v{version}'s body.
versions.footerNote: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
